auth.loginMetaDesc: Log in to GatVuller to book last-minute hours or manage your business.
auth.demoNote: Test mode: you can log in with the demo accounts klant@, salon@ and admin@gatvuller.be. The password is in the README. These accounts do not work in production.

field.name: Enter your name (at least 2 characters).
field.password: Choose a password of 8 to 72 characters.
field.terms: Tick the box to agree and continue.
field.salonName: Enter the name of your business.
field.city: Choose a city from the list.
field.address: Enter a full address, with street and number.
field.businessNumber: This company number is not correct. Check the digits or leave it empty.

auth.registerMetaDesc: Create a free account to book last-minute hours, or register your business to offer a free hour.
auth.registerLead: Free. First choose what you want to do.
auth.name: Name
auth.passwordRules: At least {min} characters. A sentence of a few words works well.
auth.businessReview: We check every business before it becomes visible to customers. A person does this; you will get an email as soon as it is done.
auth.cityNote: We are starting in {cities}. More cities will follow.
auth.addressHint: Street, number and town. Customers see the place on the map.
auth.businessNumberHint: For example 0123.456.789. With this number we can check your business faster.
auth.consent: I agree to the <terms>terms of use</terms> and the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.
auth.forgotMetaDesc: Request a link to choose a new password.
auth.forgotLead: Enter your email address. We will send you a link to choose a new password.
auth.forgotSent: If we know this email address, you will shortly receive an email with a link. The link works for 1 hour. Check your spam folder too.
auth.forgotDemo: Test mode without an email provider: the email is in the email outbox on the admin page.
auth.resetMetaDesc: Choose a new password for your account.
auth.resetLead: Choose a new password for your account.
auth.resetDone: Your password has been changed. You are logged out on other devices.
auth.resetNoToken: This link is incomplete. Request a new one.

account.metaDesc: Manage your details, your password and your privacy.
account.title: Account
account.name: Name
account.phoneHint: Only visible to the business where you book.
account.phoneError: This phone number is too long.
account.languageHint: For the site and for our emails.
account.marketingHint: Off by default. You always receive emails about your bookings and your account.
account.passwordLead: After you change it, you are logged out on your other devices.
account.passwordChanged: Your password has been changed. You are logged out on other devices.
account.exportLead: Download everything GatVuller keeps about you as a JSON file: your profile, bookings, reviews, favourites and alerts.
account.exportNote: Need access or a correction? Email {email}.
account.erasureLead: If you delete your account, we anonymise it. This cannot be undone.
account.erasureGoes: Your name, email address, phone number, password, favourites, alerts and the text of your reviews.
account.erasureStays: Your bookings remain without a name, as financial records: date, amount and business. This is needed for accounting and for disputes.
account.erasureBlockers: You cannot delete your account while you have a paid appointment that has not passed yet, or while you manage a business. Settle that first or contact us.
account.erasureUnderstood: I understand that my account will be anonymised and that this cannot be undone.

contact.metaDesc: Ask a question about a booking, your business or your privacy.
contact.title: Contact
contact.lead: A question about a booking, your business or your data? Email us or use the form.
contact.name: Name
contact.messageHint: Between 10 and 2,000 characters. If it is about a booking, include your confirmation code.
contact.sent: Sent. We will reply to the email address you gave.
contact.storedTest: Test mode: no email provider is set up. Your message was only kept in the test outbox and nobody has read it. Email us directly at {email}.
contact.failed: Your message could not be sent. Email us directly at {email}.

invite.metaDesc: Share your personal link with a customer or a business.
invite.title: Invite a customer or a business
invite.lead: Share your personal link. We only remember that the new account arrived through your code. There is no reward attached.
invite.note: The link only contains your invitation code, no personal data.

system.errorBody: The page could not be loaded. Please try again. If it keeps failing, contact us.
system.notFoundBody: The link is out of date or the address is wrong. Perhaps the hour has already been booked.

errors.auth_register_failed: We cannot create an account with these details. Already have an account? Log in or request a new password.
errors.auth_business_incomplete: Enter the name, city, category and address of your business. We are only starting in the cities and categories in the list.
errors.auth_business_number_invalid: This company number is not correct. Check the digits or leave the field empty.
errors.auth_password_wrong: Your current password is not correct.

admin.queueLead: Check before approving: look up the company number in KBO Public Search and compare the name and address.
admin.stripeReview: Details submitted, Stripe is still checking
admin.suspendHint: The owner receives this reason by email and it is kept in the log. Open hours are withdrawn and upcoming paid bookings are refunded.
admin.healthLead: Only what is set up, never keys or values.
admin.modeStripeTest: Stripe test mode: no real money
admin.modeNone: Not configured: paying is not possible
admin.emailOff: No provider: emails are not sent
admin.cronUnset: No secret: the job cannot run
admin.cronUnknown: Not recorded: the cron writes no log line
admin.totalsLead: Live, test and demo are kept apart. Only paid bookings count.
admin.funnelLead: Number of events per step, with the share of the previous step below it.
admin.funnelNote: These are events, not unique visitors. In test mode, test traffic counts.
admin.funnelFew: Not much data yet: percentages say little.
